desc: The COMP X Hunter is Kimber's first production compensated 1911. This new Kimber features a patent pending compensator and a toolless plunger which makes removal and cleaning easy. This new single stack pistol holds 8 rounds and is designed to be the first in a limited group of dedicated 10mm hunting pistols for modern pistol hunters looking to carry afield or at the range. Each model is optics ready and works with Kimber's optic plate mounting system and comes standard with a gray and black KimPro Finish and G-10 Grips
